create_random_k_frames_selector: create a RandomKFramesSelector to select k random frames from a list of frame timestamps
create_first_k_frames_selector: create a FirstKFramesSelector to select the first k frames from a list of frame timestamps
create_last_k_frames_selector: create a LastKFramesSelector to select the last k frames from a list of frame timestamps
use_frameselectionstrategy_enum: use the FrameSelectionStrategy enum to choose between random_k, first_k, last_k, or all frame selection strategies
build_frame_selector_cli: build a python module to select frames from video data using RandomKFramesSelector, FirstKFramesSelector, or LastKFramesSelector
